To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Subject: Request: Private/VPC pilot for POC (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Olga,

We signed up through the self-serve flow and evaluated some hosted responses — thanks for the quick access. We have a pilot budget to test a private/VPC deployment (HIPAA scope) and would like to kick off a short POC focused on tenant isolation and audit logging.

Primary constraints: our infra team needs to confirm IP allowlists, KMS integration (Azure Key Vault), and an initial data retention policy. Our security lead (cc'd: it_admin@medicare-solutions.com) needs an SSO/KMS checklist before we lock a slot.

Can someone from your team run a 30–45m pilot kickoff next week? We prefer mornings PT. Attendees: me (Product), Raj Patel (Data Eng), and our Security Lead (will confirm name).

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Senior Product Manager
Medicare Solutions

Date: 2027-04-02T11:20:00-07:00
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@medicare-solutions.com>, olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, it_admin@medicare-solutions.com
Subject: Re: Request: Private/VPC pilot for POC (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Tara — Connor from Redwood infra team. Quick technical checklist/questions to help us prep the pilot environment: 

1) Allowlist
- Do you have a static perimeter IP block (CIDR) or will you allow a short-lived range? If static, please share the IPs.

2) KMS
- You mentioned Azure Key Vault. Are you managing keys or will Redwood generate a CMK? We support customer-managed keys via Azure Key Vault integration; need a contact who can grant the outbound access or confirm the policy.

3) Network access
- Will the pilot need a private peering (VPC peering) or can we use a NAT/egress pattern with cert-based mTLS?

4) Attendees/roles
- Please confirm the security lead's name and their preferred level of technical detail (high-level vs. deep ops).

5) Evidence
- I'll attach a short SOC2 summary and our pilot SOW template to this thread for your security team to review. Any additional compliance docs needed?

If you can confirm basic answers before the kickoff, we can keep the session demo-focused and use less time on intake.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick answers and clarifications: 

- We can do Tue 2027-04-06 09:00 PT — that works for Product and Data Eng.
- Security lead will be Priya Narang (cc'd it_admin for now) and she prefers an ops-focused call.
- IPs: we can provide a /28 static range from our perimeter; I will follow up with the exact list this afternoon.
- KMS: we manage keys in Azure Key Vault; Priya will coordinate access. We do not want Redwood to generate CMKs for this pilot.
- Network: prefer NAT with outbound allowlist for the initial pilot, but would like to discuss peering if throughput is a blocker.
- Evidence: SOC2 summary and SOW look good — please send the files.

Tara
